Christmas After Hours

by: Michael Ruiz

Tapes of empty places on Christmas, recorded when nobody's around. Each one has its own carol playing somewhere in the building. Pick a tape and press Sound.

How to watch
  • Click the picture: sparks fly, and some tapes answer back.
  • Wander: doors, windows, TVs and the picture's edges show an arrow and take you somewhere nearby.
  • Sightings: every tape hides one rare moment. Click Santa to say hello. Catch five to unlock a secret tape.
  • Keys: Space pause · hold F/R fast-forward/rewind · ←→ change tape · G guide · N map · M mute · Esc shelf
  • Buttons: Radio keeps a station playing between tapes · Live uses your clock · Voices and Captions for announcements.
  • Headphones: the music sits in the room; move the mouse to turn your head. WASD walks in the yellow rooms.

About

Christmas After Hours was created by Michael Ruiz: a shelf of home-recorded tapes of empty places on the holiday, from 1985 to 2050, each with its own carol playing somewhere in the building.
